description_en: Creates a batch C2PA content credential signing task for files in a specified OSS bucket
description_zh: 创建指定OSS Bucket内文件的批量C2PA内容凭证签名任务
kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-c-2-pa-bucket-sign-task --bucket-region-id cn-hangzhou --bucket-name example-bucket --source-prefix ai-deepsign/images/ --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateC2paBucketSignTask

parameters.help_en: The region of the OSS bucket. The value can be up to 64 characters in length and must match the actual region of the bucket. Example: `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.help_zh: OSS Bucket 所在地域，最多 64 个字符，必须与 Bucket 的实际地域一致。例如 `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.name: bucket_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket. The value must be 3 to 63 characters in length. Before you call this operation, you must authorize the `AliyunServiceRoleForAIDeepSign` service-linked role to read the source files, and access and write the signing results and reports
parameters.help_zh: OSS Bucket 名称，长度为 3～63 个字符。调用前需授权服务关联角色 `AliyunServiceRoleForAIDeepSign` 读取源文件，并访问和写入签名结果及报告
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the objects to be processed. The value can be up to 1,023 UTF-8 bytes in length and must be `ai-deepsign/` or its subdirectory. If the trailing `/` is missing, the service automatically appends it, and the completed prefix must also meet the length limit. The service recursively processes non-directory objects under this prefix and supports `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.mp4`, `.flac`, `.m4a`, `.mp3`, and `.wav` extensions, which are case-insensitive. Scanning the root directory of the bucket is not allowed, and the prefix cannot overlap with the output prefix `ai-deepsign-signed/`
parameters.help_zh: 待处理对象前缀，最长 1023 个 UTF-8 字节，必须为 `ai-deepsign/` 或其子目录；缺少末尾 `/` 时服务会自动补齐，补齐后的前缀也须满足长度限制。服务递归处理该前缀下的非目录对象，支持 `.jpg`、`.jpeg`、`.png`、`.mp4`、`.flac`、`.m4a`、`.mp3`、`.wav`，扩展名大小写不敏感。不允许扫描 Bucket 根目录，也不能与输出前缀 `ai-deepsign-signed/` 重叠
parameters.name: source_prefix

parameters.help_en: The optional content source type. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It supports 19 short names and their corresponding full HTTP URIs, which are case-sensitive. Examples: `digitalCapture` and `trainedAlgorithmicMedia`. The source declaration is written into the content credential of the signature file. Each file in the same batch uses the value saved when the task is created. If this parameter is left empty, no additional declaration is made. The service will deny invalid values during the creation phase. For the complete enumeration and URIs, see the supplementary description of request parameters
parameters.help_zh: 可选的内容来源类型，最多 128 个字符。支持 19 个短名称及其对应的完整 HTTP URI，区分大小写；例如 `digitalCapture`、`trainedAlgorithmicMedia`。来源声明会写入签名文件的内容凭证。同一批次每个文件使用创建任务时保存的值；未填写则不额外声明，非法值在创建阶段拒绝。完整枚举和 URI 见请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The optional name of the software that generated or processed the content. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. Example: `Example Studio 1.0`. This software information is written into the content credential of the signature file. Each file in the same batch uses the value saved when the task is created. The original value is retained after the task is paused and resumed
parameters.help_zh: 可选的生成或处理内容的软件名称，最多 128 个字符，例如 `Example Studio 1.0`。该软件信息会写入签名文件的内容凭证。同一批次每个文件使用创建任务时保存的值；暂停和恢复后仍沿用原值
parameters.name: software_agent

parameters.help_en: The optional list of custom assertions. Pass a JSON array string. The original JSON text can be up to 4,096 UTF-8 bytes in length and contain up to 64 assertions. Each item must and can only contain `label` and `data`. `data` supports any JSON value. Objects and arrays can be nested up to 5 levels deep, and JSON integers must be within the signed 64-bit range. The assertions are written into the manifest of the signature file and can be read and authenticated for integrity by `label`. Each file in the same batch uses the same set of assertions. The content saved during creation is retained after the task is paused and resumed. For detailed formats, limits, and examples, see the supplementary description of request parameters
parameters.help_zh: 可选的自定义声明列表，请传入 JSON 数组字符串。原始 JSON 文本最多 4096 个 UTF-8 字节、最多 64 条声明；每项必须且只能包含 `label` 和 `data`。`data` 支持任意 JSON 值，对象和数组最多嵌套 5 层，JSON 整数须在有符号 64 位范围内。声明将写入签名文件的 Manifest，可按 `label` 读取并验证完整性。同一批次每个文件使用同一组声明；暂停和恢复后继续使用创建时保存的内容。详细格式、限制及示例见请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: custom_assertions

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the batch signing task for the bucket. You can use this ID to query, pause, resume, or stop the task
TaskId.description_zh: Bucket批量签名任务ID，可用于查询、暂停、恢复或终止任务
TaskId.title_en: Bucket批量签名任务ID，可用于查询、暂停、恢复或终止任务
TaskId.title_zh: Bucket批量签名任务ID，可用于查询、暂停、恢复或终止任务
